items.meaning: 会话被视为参与者关联之间的一次数据交换。
SIP 是一个与承载实时多媒体会话数据的其它协议协同工作的协议。
SIP 是应与其他协议配合使用以向用户提供完整服务的协议。
SIP 本身不提供服务，只提供可用于实现各种服务的原语。
关键词 MUST 按 BCP 14/RFC 2119 解释，表示合规 SIP 实现的需求等级。
INVITE 是文本编码消息首行中出现的方法名。
代理服务器接收 SIP 请求并代表请求方转发它们。
Via 头域用于携带代理服务器自身地址等值。
位置服务是代理服务器查询的、包含目标当前 IP 地址的数据库。
Bob 的 SIP 电话接收 INVITE，并提醒 Bob 有来自 Alice 的来电。
每个代理使用 Via 头域确定将响应发送到哪里，并从顶部移除自己的地址。
每个代理使用 Via 头域确定将响应发送到哪里，并从顶部移除自己的地址。
示例中路由初始 INVITE 需要 DNS 查找。
示例中路由初始 INVITE 需要位置服务查找。
180 响应可以在没有查找或状态的情况下返回给主叫。
Alice 的软电话接收 180 响应，并将此信息传递给 Alice。
Alice 的软电话接收 180 响应，并将此信息传递给 Alice。
Bob 的 SIP 电话发送 200 响应以表示通话已接听。
200 响应包含带有 Bob 愿意建立的会话类型的 SDP 媒体描述的消息体。
SDP 媒体描述说明 Bob 愿意与 Alice 建立的会话类型。
两阶段交换提供基本协商能力，并基于简单的 SDP offer/answer 模型。
如果 Bob 不想接听或正忙，则会发送错误响应而不是 200 响应，并且不会建立媒体会话。
SIP 响应码的完整列表在 Section 21 中。
200 响应在 Figure 1 中标记为消息 F9。
Figure 1 中 200 响应的消息标签。
包含消息 F9 的图。
代理服务器可以做出灵活的路由决策来决定将请求发送到哪里。
代理服务器可以做出的、用于决定请求发送目的地的灵活决策。
Bob 的 SIP 电话可能返回的忙响应；示例中代理可据此将 INVITE 转发到语音信箱。
在收到 486 响应时，可以把 INVITE 代理到 Bob 的语音信箱服务器。
示例中 biloxi.com 代理服务器可将 INVITE 代理到的语音信箱服务器。
代理服务器可以同时向多个位置发送 INVITE。
并行搜索这种类型被称为 forking。
forking 是并行搜索这种类型的名称。
会话期间 Alice 或 Bob 可以决定改变媒体会话特性。
items.constraint: may decide to change the characteristics of the media session
items.condition: During the session

items.meaning: re-INVITE 携带新的媒体描述并引用现有 dialog 以修改现有会话。
另一方发送 200 (OK) 以接受变更。
请求方用 ACK 回应 200 (OK)。
若不接受变更，发送 488 (Not Acceptable Here) 错误响应，该响应也接收 ACK。
re-INVITE 失败不会导致现有呼叫失败，会话继续使用先前协商的特性。
SIP 信令路径中的代理可能看到端点之间的全部消息。
若希望留在初始 INVITE 之后的 SIP 消息路径中，可在 INVITE 中添加 Record-Route 头域。
每个代理可独立决定接收后续消息，这些消息会经过所有选择接收它的代理。
SIP 被构造为分层协议。
当说一个元素“包含”某层时，是指它遵循该层定义的规则。
事务层之上的层称为事务用户（TU）。
除无状态代理外，每个 SIP 实体都是事务用户。
创建客户端事务的 TU 也可以取消该事务。
客户端取消事务时请求服务器停止处理、回退状态并生成特定错误响应。
CANCEL 请求构成自身的事务，但引用要取消的事务。
SIP 元素包含区分彼此的核心。
除无状态代理外，核心是事务用户。
对 UAC，这些通用规则约束请求的构造。
对 UAS，这些规则约束请求处理和响应生成。
处理 REGISTER 的 UAS 称为 registrar。
OPTIONS 方法用于确定 UA 的能力。
A dialog is a peer-to-peer SIP relationship between two user agents that persists for some time.
The INVITE method is the only way defined in this specification to establish a dialog.
When a UAC sends a request within the context of a dialog, it follows the common UAC rules discussed in Section 8 and the rules for mid-dialog requests.
A back-to-back user agent (B2BUA) is a logical entity that receives a request and processes it as a UAS, and acts as a UAC to generate requests.
A B2BUA must participate in all requests sent on the dialogs it has established.
items.constraint: must participate in all requests sent on the dialogs it has established
items.object: all requests sent on the dialogs it has established

items.meaning: A proxy is call stateful if it retains state for a dialog from the initiating INVITE to the terminating BYE request.
A call stateful proxy is always transaction stateful, but the converse is not necessarily true.
A client is any network element that sends SIP requests and receives SIP responses.
Clients may or may not interact directly with a human user.
User agent clients and proxies are clients.
Core designates the functions specific to a particular type of SIP entity, such as a stateful or stateless proxy, a user agent, or registrar.
All cores, except those for the stateless proxy, are transaction users.
A request that arrives at a proxy, is forwarded, and later arrives back at the same proxy with identical Request-URI and unchanged proxy-affecting header fields.
items.constraint: Looped requests are errors.

items.meaning: In a loop, the Request-URI is identical to the first time the request arrived.
items.constraint: its Request-URI is identical to the first time

items.meaning: A proxy is loose routing if it follows this specification's procedures for processing the Route header field.
items.constraint: A proxy is said to be loose routing if it follows the procedures defined in this specification for processing of the Route header field.

items.meaning: The header field whose processing procedures define loose routing.
items.constraint: the procedures defined in this specification for processing of the Route header field

items.meaning: The Request-URI contains the destination of the request.
items.constraint: destination of the request (present in the Request-URI)

items.meaning: A proxy that receives requests from a client even though it may not be the server resolved by the Request-URI.
items.constraint: A proxy that receives requests from a client, even though it may not be the server resolved by the Request-URI.

items.meaning: A UA is typically manually configured with an outbound proxy or can learn about one through auto-configuration protocols.
items.constraint: Typically, a UA is manually configured with an outbound proxy, or can learn about one through auto-configuration protocols.

items.meaning: An intermediary entity that acts as both a server and a client for making requests on behalf of other clients.
items.constraint: acts as both a server and a client for the purpose of making requests on behalf of other clients

items.meaning: A proxy interprets, and if necessary rewrites, specific parts of a request message before forwarding it.
items.constraint: A proxy interprets, and, if necessary, rewrites specific parts of a request message before forwarding it.

items.meaning: A client recurses on a 3xx response when it generates a new request to one or more URIs in the Contact header field in the response.
items.constraint: A client recurses on a 3xx response when it generates a new request to one or more of the URIs in the Contact header field in the response.

items.meaning: The Contact header is the header field in the response containing URIs to which a new request may be generated during recursion.
items.constraint: one or more of the URIs in the Contact header field in the response

items.meaning: 路由集是有序的 SIP 或 SIPS URI 集合，表示发送某一请求时必须经过的代理列表。
items.constraint: 代理在发送某一请求时必须被穿越
items.object: a list of proxies represented by a collection of ordered SIP or SIPS URI
items.condition: when sending a particular request

items.meaning: 按 SDP 定义，会话由多媒体发送方和接收方以及数据流组成，并由 origin 字段中 SDP 用户名、会话 id、网络类型、地址类型和地址元素拼接定义。
若请求是 INVITE 且最终响应为非 2xx，则事务还包含对响应的 ACK；对 INVITE 的 2xx 响应的 ACK 是独立事务。
螺旋是指被路由到某代理、被转发后再次到达该代理但处理决策不同的 SIP 请求，它不是错误情况而是一种有效情况。
无状态代理是在处理请求时不维护本规范所定义的客户端或服务器事务状态机的逻辑实体，它将收到的每个请求向下游转发、每个响应向上游转发。
代理若遵循 RFC 2543 及本 RFC 早期草案版本的 Route 处理规则，则被称为 strict routing。
items.constraint: Strict routing behavior is not used in this specification

items.meaning: 在被处理请求的 Route 头域存在时，该规则曾导致代理破坏 Request-URI 的内容。
执行严格路由的代理也被称为 strict routers。
一个创建新请求并使用客户端事务状态机发送它的逻辑实体。
UAC 角色只在对应事务存续期间有效。
若 UAC 之后收到请求，则在该事务处理过程中承担用户代理服务器（UAS）的角色。
UAC 所需的处理功能集合，位于事务层与传输层之上。
一个对 SIP 请求生成响应的逻辑实体；该响应可以接受、拒绝或重定向该请求。
若 UAS 之后生成请求，则在该事务处理过程中承担用户代理客户端（UAC）的角色。
UAS 所需的处理功能集合，位于事务层与传输层之上。
同一用户代理在发送初始 INVITE 请求时充当 UAC 角色，该角色按事务逐笔定义
同一用户代理在接收被叫方发来的 BYE 请求时充当 UAS 角色
同一软件可对一个请求充当代理服务器，而对下一个请求充当重定向服务器
同一软件可对下一个请求充当重定向服务器
上文定义的代理、位置与注册服务器都是逻辑实体
实现可以将代理、位置与注册服务器这些逻辑实体组合成单一应用
请求消息使用 RFC 2822 的基本格式，尽管字符集与语法细节不同
响应消息使用 RFC 2822 的基本格式，尽管字符集与语法细节不同
起始行、每个消息头行以及空行必须以 CRLF 序列结尾
items.constraint: 必须以 carriage-return line-feed sequence (CRLF) 终止

items.meaning: 即使没有消息体，空行也必须存在
items.constraint: 空行必须存在
items.condition: even if the message-body is not

items.meaning: 除字符集差异外，SIP 的消息与头域语法很大部分与 HTTP/1.1 相同，故以 [HX.Y] 引用 HTTP/1.1 规范章节
Request-Line 以 CRLF 结束
除行尾 CRLF 序列之外，不允许出现 CR 或 LF
items.constraint: No CR or LF are allowed except in the end-of-line CRLF sequence
items.exception: except in the end-of-line CRLF sequence

items.meaning: 任何元素中都不允许出现线性空白（LWS）
items.constraint: No linear whitespace (LWS) is allowed in any of the elements
items.object: linear whitespace (LWS) in any of the elements

items.meaning: 本规范定义了六个方法：REGISTER、INVITE、ACK、CANCEL、BYE、OPTIONS
Request-URI 是 Section 19.1 描述的 SIP 或 SIPS URI，或一般 URI（RFC 2396），指示请求所指向的用户或服务
Request-URI 不得包含未转义的空格或控制字符，也不得用 "<>" 括起来
items.constraint: The Request-URI MUST NOT contain unescaped spaces or control characters and MUST NOT be enclosed in "<>"

items.meaning: SIP 元素可以支持 "sip" 和 "sips" 之外的 URI 方案（如 "tel"）
items.object: Request-URIs with schemes other than "sip" and "sips"

items.meaning: SIP 元素可以用其可用的任意机制转换非 SIP URI
items.object: non-SIP URIs using any mechanism at their disposal

items.meaning: 为符合本规范，发送 SIP 消息的应用必须包含 "SIP/2.0" 的 SIP-Version

items.constraint: implementations MUST send upper-case

items.meaning: SIP 将版本号当作字面字符串处理（与 HTTP/1.1 不同）
除结尾的 CRLF 序列外，不允许出现 CR 或 LF
items.constraint: No CR or LF is allowed except in the final CRLF sequence.

items.meaning: 3 位整数结果码，表示服务器理解或满足请求的结果
用于向人类用户提供 Status-Code 简短文本描述的短语
实现可以为 reason phrase 选择其他文本（如请求 Accept-Language 所指示的语言）
items.condition: While this specification suggests specific wording for the reason phrase

items.meaning: 4xx 表示客户端错误：请求语法有误或无法在该服务器被满足

6xx denotes Global Failure, meaning the request cannot be fulfilled at any server.
The Contact header field allows a comma-separated list unless the header field value is "*".
items.constraint: unless the header field value is "*"

items.meaning: Implementations should avoid spaces between the field name and the colon and use a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value.
items.constraint: avoid spaces between field name and colon; use single SP between colon and field-value
items.action: avoid spaces between the field name and the colon and use a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value
items.object: spaces between the field name and the colon; a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value

items.meaning: The relative order of header fields with different field names is not significant.
It is RECOMMENDED that header fields needed for proxy processing appear towards the top of the message to facilitate rapid parsing.
items.constraint: header fields needed for proxy processing appear towards the top of the message
items.action: appear towards the top of the message
items.object: header fields needed for proxy processing (Via, Route, Record-Route, Proxy-Require, Max-Forwards, and Proxy-Authorization)

items.meaning: The relative order of header field rows with the same field name is important.
Multiple header field rows with the same field-name MAY be present in a message if and only if the entire field-value for that header field is defined as a comma-separated list per Section 7.3.
items.constraint: MAY be present iff field-value is defined as comma-separated list
items.object: Multiple header field rows with the same field-name
items.condition: if and only if the entire field-value for that header field is defined as a comma-separated list (that is, if follows the grammar defined in Section 7.3)
items.exception: WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Proxy-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authorization header fields

items.meaning: It MUST be possible to combine multiple header field rows into one "field-name: field-value" pair without changing the semantics of the message.
items.constraint: combine multiple header field rows into one pair without changing semantics
items.action: combine the multiple header field rows into one "field-name: field-value" pair
items.exception: WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Proxy-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authorization header fields

items.meaning: WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Proxy-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authorization are exceptions to the rule about multiple header field rows.
items.constraint: exceptions to the multiple header field rows rule

items.meaning: 这些名称的字段行可以出现在消息中
这些名称的字段行不得合并为单个头字段行
items.constraint: MUST NOT be combined into a single header field row
items.condition: their grammar does not follow the general form listed in Section 7.3

items.meaning: 实现必须能够处理同名多行头字段的各种取值形式组合
items.constraint: MUST be able to process multiple header field rows with the same name in any combination of the single-value-per-line or comma-separated value forms
items.object: multiple header field rows with the same name in any combination of the single-value-per-line or comma-separated value forms

items.meaning: 任一参数名在头字段值中不得出现多于一次
items.constraint: MUST NOT appear more than once

items.meaning: 比较头字段时字段名总是大小写不敏感的
除非特定头字段定义另有规定，字段值、参数名和参数值大小写不敏感
token 总是大小写不敏感的
以带引号字符串表达的值除非另有规定否则大小写敏感
示例中出现的头字段名，取值含 handling 参数为 optional
一个头字段名，示例取值为 Session，处理方式为 OPTIONAL。
消息头部中出现的字段（分为请求头字段与响应头字段）。
items.constraint: 若头字段出现在与其类别不匹配的消息中（如响应中出现请求头字段），则必须忽略它。
items.object: header field appearing in a message not matching its category
items.condition: If a header field appears in a message not matching its category (such as a request header field in a response)

items.meaning: 头字段的名称；在消息中转义时可使用该名称的紧凑缩写形式。
items.constraint: 以紧凑形式替代长形式时不得改变消息的语义。
items.condition: at any time

items.meaning: 头字段名称可在同一消息内同时出现长形式与短形式。
items.object: both long and short forms within the same message
items.condition: within the same message

items.meaning: 实现方（协议实现）。
items.constraint: 实现必须同时接受每个头字段名的长形式与短形式。
items.object: both the long and short forms of each header name

items.meaning: SIP 请求消息（含扩展定义的新请求）。
items.constraint: 除非另有说明，请求可以携带消息体。

items.meaning: 响应消息可包含消息体
items.constraint: All responses MAY include a body.

items.meaning: 消息体的 Internet 媒体类型须由 Content-Type 头域给出

items.object: the Internet media type of the message body

items.condition: If the body has undergone any encoding such as compression

items.meaning: 消息体未经过编码时，须省略 Content-Encoding 头域
items.constraint: otherwise, Content-Encoding MUST be omitted.
items.condition: otherwise

items.condition: if the remote implementation requests this through an Accept header field that does not contain multipart

items.meaning: SIP 消息可包含二进制消息体或消息体部分

items.meaning: 发送方未显式给出 charset 参数时，text 类型的媒体子类型默认字符集为 UTF-8
HTTP/1.1 的 chunked 传输编码不得用于 SIP
items.constraint: The "chunked" transfer encoding of HTTP/1.1 MUST NOT be used for SIP.

items.meaning: SIP implementations can use UDP or other unreliable datagram protocols.
Each datagram carries one request or response.

items.object: any CRLF appearing before the start-line
items.condition: processing SIP messages over stream-oriented transports
items.normative_subject: Implementations processing SIP messages over stream-oriented transports

items.meaning: The value is used to locate the end of each SIP message in a stream and is always present when SIP messages are sent over stream-oriented transports.
When a UAC sends a request, the request passes through proxy servers.
Proxy servers forward the request towards the UAS.
When the UAS generates a response, the response is forwarded towards the UAC.
This section discusses method-independent rules for UAC behavior when processing requests outside a dialog, including requests that establish a dialog.
This section discusses method-independent rules for UAS behavior when processing requests outside a dialog, including requests that establish a dialog.
User Agent Client formulates valid SIP requests that must contain certain header fields.
items.constraint: A valid SIP request formulated by a UAC MUST contain To, From, CSeq, Call-ID, Max-Forwards, and Via header fields.
items.object: To, From, CSeq, Call-ID, Max-Forwards, and Via header fields
items.normative_subject: A valid SIP request formulated by a UAC

items.meaning: The initial Request-URI of a SIP message should be set to the URI in the To field.
items.constraint: SHOULD be set to the value of the URI in the To field, except for REGISTER.
items.object: to the value of the URI in the To field
items.normative_subject: The initial Request-URI of the message

items.meaning: A UAC sends outgoing requests outside a dialog to a chain of servers identified by a pre-existing route set.

items.constraint: RECOMMENDED that this be done by providing it with a pre-existing route set with a single URI, that of the outbound proxy.
items.object: a pre-existing route set with a single URI, that of the outbound proxy
items.condition: When a provider wishes to configure a UA with an outbound proxy

items.object: procedures for populating the Request-URI and Route header field detailed in Section 12.2.1.1
items.condition: When a pre-existing route set is present
items.exception: even though there is no dialog

items.meaning: The To header field specifies the desired logical recipient or address-of-record of the target user or resource.
The To header field may contain a SIP or SIPS URI.
items.constraint: MAY contain a SIP or SIPS URI.

items.meaning: All SIP implementations must support the SIP URI scheme.
items.constraint: MUST support the SIP URI scheme.

items.meaning: An implementation that supports TLS must support the SIPS URI scheme.
items.constraint: MUST support the SIPS URI scheme if it supports TLS.
items.condition: that supports TLS

items.meaning: A UAC may learn how to populate the To header field for a particular request in a number of ways.
It is at the discretion of the UA to choose how to interpret input used to populate the To header field.
Using a string to form the user part of a SIP URI implies that the UA wishes the name to be resolved in the domain on the right-hand side of the at-sign.
Using a string to form the user part of a SIPS URI implies that the UA wishes to communicate securely and that the name is to be resolved in the domain on the right-hand side of the at-sign.
The tel URL may be used when the UA does not wish to specify the domain that should interpret a telephone number input by the user.
A request outside of a dialog must not contain a To tag, and the tag in the To field of a request identifies the peer of the dialog.

items.condition: outside of a dialog

items.meaning: The tag in the To field of a request identifies the peer of the dialog.
Further information on the To header field is in Section 20.39.
The From header field indicates the logical identity of the initiator of the request, possibly the user's address-of-record.
SIP elements use the From header field to determine which processing rules to apply to a request.
It is very important that the From URI not contain IP addresses or the FQDN of the host on which the UA is running.
The From header field allows for a display name.
A UAC SHOULD use the display name "Anonymous" with a syntactically correct but otherwise meaningless URI if the identity of the client is to remain hidden.
items.constraint: SHOULD use the display name "Anonymous" along with a syntactically correct, but otherwise meaningless URI if the identity of the client is to remain hidden
items.object: the display name "Anonymous", along with a syntactically correct, but otherwise meaningless URI (like sip:thisis@anonymous.invalid)
items.condition: if the identity of the client is to remain hidden

items.meaning: 请求中 From 头域的值通常由用户或用户本地域的管理员预置，且请求的接收方可对发起者进行认证以确认其身份与 From 头域声明一致
From 头域必须包含一个新的由 UAC 选择的 tag 参数
items.constraint: The From field MUST contain a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC.
items.object: a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC

items.meaning: 关于 From 头域的更多信息参见 Section 20.20
Call-ID 头域作为把一系列消息分组的唯一标识符，在对话中任一 UA 发送的所有请求和响应中必须相同
items.constraint: It MUST be the same for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog.
items.object: for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog

items.meaning: 同一 UA 的每次注册中 Call-ID 应当相同
items.constraint: It SHOULD be the same in each registration from a UA.
items.object: in each registration from a UA

items.meaning: 在任意对话之外由 UAC 创建的新请求中，Call-ID 头域必须由 UAC 选为在时间和空间上全局唯一的标识符
items.constraint: In a new request created by a UAC outside of any dialog, the Call-ID header field MUST be selected by the UAC as a globally unique identifier over space and time unless overridden by method-specific behavior.
items.action: be selected as a globally unique identifier over space and time
items.condition: In a new request created by a UAC outside of any dialog

items.meaning: 所有 SIP UA 必须拥有手段保证其产生的 Call-ID 头域不会被任何其他 UA 无意中生成
items.constraint: All SIP UAs must have a means to guarantee that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA.
items.object: that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA

items.meaning: Retried requests caused by failure responses are not considered new requests and do not need new Call-ID header fields.
Use of cryptographically random identifiers in generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED.
items.constraint: Use of cryptographically random identifiers in generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED
items.object: cryptographically random identifiers (RFC 1750 [12]) in the generation of Call-IDs

items.meaning: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host".
items.constraint: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host"

items.meaning: Call-IDs are case-sensitive and are compared byte-by-byte.
No provisioning or human interface is required for selecting the Call-ID header field value for a request.
Further information on the Call-ID header field is in Section 20.8.
The CSeq header field identifies and orders transactions and consists of a sequence number and a method.
The CSeq method MUST match the method of the request.
items.constraint: method MUST match that of the request

items.meaning: For non-REGISTER requests outside a dialog, the sequence number value is arbitrary.
The CSeq sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer and MUST be less than 2**31.
items.constraint: sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer and MUST be less than 2**31
items.action: be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer and be less than 2**31

items.meaning: As long as it follows the above guidelines, a client may use any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values.
items.constraint: a client may use any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values
items.object: any mechanism it would like to select CSeq header field values
items.condition: As long as it follows the above guidelines
